description: Answer questions about what is near a location, what neighborhood a coordinate is in, or what places are within walking/driving distance. Use this when given coordinates and asked about nearby places, neighborhood context, local discovery, or area summaries. It already includes reverse geocoding, so a separate reverse_geocode_tool call is not needed for the same coordinate. Pass the place category (e.g. "restaurant", "coffee", "park") as the query parameter to get nearby POIs in the same call. Returns place name, nearby POIs matching the query, and travel-time reachability — all sourced from live Mapbox data with citations.

contours_minutes.description: Travel-time thresholds in minutes for the isochrone. Max 4 values, each between 1-60.

language.description: IETF language tag for the response (e.g., "en", "es", "fr", "de", "ja")

latitude.description: Latitude of the location to ground responses around

limit.description: Maximum number of nearby POIs to return (1-25)

longitude.description: Longitude of the location to ground responses around

profile.description: Travel profile for isochrone calculation. Use "mapbox/driving-traffic" for traffic-aware driving. Defaults to "mapbox/walking".

query.description: Optional category or type of places to search for nearby (e.g., "restaurant", "coffee", "park"). If omitted, returns general place context only.

name: ground_location_tool

citations.description: Mapbox APIs used to produce this grounded response

mapboxRender.description: Map-payload reference for `render_map_tool`. Surfaced so the LLM can chain the next call without re-emitting geometry.

ref.description: Server-side payload reference. Pass to `render_map_tool` via `payload_refs: ["<this ref>"]` to display the data on a live Mapbox GL JS map.

nearby_pois.description: Nearby points of interest matching the query

external_ids.description: Upstream supplier ids for this place, keyed by supplier (e.g. dataplor, tripadvisor). Use to attribute where the record came from.

mapbox_id.description: Mapbox id for this place. Pass it to place_details_tool to retrieve ratings, popularity, opening hours, and phone number.

place.description: Human-readable place name from reverse geocoding

title: Ground Location Tool
